genuine_tuned_sc_accuracy.principle: the GENUINE K-way tuned-SC baseline from B1 (NOT the k=1 strawman) -- the honest baseline to beat.

headroom_present.principle: true required for an informative result -- (oracle@K - GENUINE tuned_sc) >= 0.10 AND flips>0 (FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK guard, vs the B1 genuine baseline).

honest_verdict.principle: terminal prefix; a win is success_lora_ebm_beats_sc_musr_<delta>, a clean null is complete_lora_ebm_no_win_musr_<delta>_ci_incl_0, a failed train is blocked_lora_ebm_train_did_not_run.

mcnemar_p.principle: McNemar paired-test p; a win requires p<0.05.

model_specs.principle: the trainable base (Qwen3.5-1.7B base + LoRA + energy head) AND the cached-candidate generator -- the methodology stamp.

n_pairs.principle: the contrastive-pair count (>0 REQUIRED -- 0 was the .461 skeleton signature).

paired_ci95.principle: paired bootstrap CI95 of the delta; a win requires CI95 excluding 0.

preconditions_checked.principle: records base-cached/CUDA/candidate-cache/FoVer checks; a missing resource emits blocked_, never a fabricated AUROC.

random_seed.principle: determinism for the train/eval split + bootstrap.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: content hash of (base, LoRA config, corpus, seed) so a replication catches drift.

scorer_trained.principle: true iff the model ACTUALLY trained (train_loss non-null, n_pairs>0, duration>60s) -- the anti-skeleton gate AND the field D3 gates on; false = a FAILED execution, not a null.

train_loss.principle: the final contrastive training loss (non-null REQUIRED -- a null means the .461 skeleton bail recurred).

trained_scorer_accuracy.principle: the oracle-distinct selection accuracy of the TRAINED LoRA-EBM (the headline number).

verifier_is_oracle.principle: false -- the scorer ranks reasoning quality and NEVER reads gold/answer_index/model_id at inference (must pass check_circular_moat_overclaim).
